invariants: Never substitute Xaman application IDs between projects.
Connection is authorization-only; no transaction payload during connect.
Remembered public account, active signing authorization and app identity are separate facts.
One deliberate write intent creates at most one Xaman payload.
CSP changes are runtime/security changes and require verification.
Do not call a green CI pipeline a live-wallet verification.
Keep resolved failures as regression fixtures with commit/pipeline evidence.
Model name/Ultra setting is not test evidence or guaranteed access.
A visible Cancel label must be exercised against a pending attempt, not just checked for string presence.
SDK construction and all awaited cleanup must obey bounded state reset and stale-attempt protection.
Use actual current LICENSE and metadata schema; stale validator constants are not authoritative.
A setup blocker intentionally failing closed must be completed with reviewed dependencies, never bypassed.
Report audited scope; do not claim all defects found.

audit.scope: Current-source static checks, selected recent diffs and CI logs, synthetic wallet probes. Not an exhaustive security audit or a live wallet/browser certification.
audit.model_attribution: No commit is attributed to a particular model tier without provenance. User requested review of recent AI-assisted work; defects are classified by evidence, not model name.

status_semantics.open: Unfixed, with evidence_level distinguishing user report, source, and synthetic reproduction.
status_semantics.retest-required: Code exists, exact real-device behavior not verified.
status_semantics.resolved: Scoped correction verified by specified evidence; never implies whole application correctness.
status_semantics.historical-reverify: Retained report, current reproduction not established.
status_semantics.no-change-this-pass: Explicitly outside application repair in this audit.
